sources.entry: Scribble.rs - A web-based pictionary game. (Demo) BSD-3-Clause Go/Docker

summary.one_liner: Scribble.rs is a free, privacy-respecting, account-free web pictionary game written in Go, positioned as an alternative to skribbl.io.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a browser-based pictionary game with no ads and no account required to play. It is presented as an alternative to skribbl.io. The server is configured through environment variables or a .env file, with settings for port, listen address, root path, CORS origins, and lobby cleanup intervals and inactivity thresholds. It can be run as a Docker container (Linux and Windows images are published) or built from source with Go into a single binary named scribblers. The server uses WebSockets, and the README includes guidance on configuring nginx as a reverse proxy. A Prometheus metrics endpoint is exposed at /v1/metrics.
use_cases: Playing pictionary with friends in the browser
Self-hosting a private drawing and guessing game
Running a community game server for others
Hosting a multiplayer game behind an nginx reverse proxy
Playing a skribbl.io-style game without an account or ads
notable: No account required and no advertisements, per the README
Single portable Go binary, or Docker images for Linux and Windows containers
Configurable via environment variables or a .env file
Documented WebSocket-compatible nginx reverse proxy setup, with a wiki page for example config
Community-hosted public instances are listed in the README
caveats: The official instance shuts down automatically when it receives no traffic, so it may respond slowly at first
Pre-compiled binaries may not be compatible with every system; Docker or compiling from source is recommended
The Discord server is described as not very active
Metrics expose limited information, and the public dashboard is not available
